geometry.uv: U=0 upstream, U=1 downstream; V=0 left, V=1 right

runtime_inputs.worldWindDirection: Normalized finite horizontal vector pointing downstream. Use no instances at zero wind.
runtime_inputs.windSpeedBUPerSecond: Nonnegative. Use runtime wind magnitude, independent from gameplay consumption.
runtime_inputs.phaseOffsetBU: Per-instance downstream phase distance in BU.
runtime_inputs.formationWeight: 0…1 optional inherited FX-001 alignment. Review uses 1, i.e. parallel wind.
runtime_inputs.opacityMultiplier: 0…1 applied to straight alpha. Feather edges or recycle.
runtime_inputs.windBearingRad: Blender preview yaw of the wind, rad. Common practice: π to reverse around the up axis.
runtime_inputs.alignment: Rotate local forward toward world wind; for S5 flying +Y, yaw π about Blender +Z (GLB +Y) for -Y wind. Keep unit positive scale and unchanged UV.
runtime_inputs.tile_and_visibility: Tile with 2.8 BU repetition along wind, at transparent endpoints. Fade instances at the review strip's recycle bounds or supply a runtime envelope. Reserve the central terminal and projected bird silhouette.
runtime_inputs.export_animation: Static GLB. Mother file supplies a Blender review timeline, and the engine supplies final advection.
